privacy.intro: SEOUL.OS is an unofficial fan tool. Here is where the data comes from and what your browser stores.
privacy.localBody: Follows, video bookmarks and language preferences are stored in this browser's localStorage, not uploaded to an account server. Clear this site's browser data to remove them.
privacy.externalBody: Video metadata is fetched server-side from the YouTube Data API and the page reads static JSON. Opening YouTube, Ticketmaster or artist sites may share your IP, browser details and cookies with those platforms. The X widget loads only after you click.
privacy.calendarBody: Ticketmaster events sync only after key and artist identity verification. We keep limited names, dates, places and source links, recheck them, and handle removals. Calendar clients control public ICS refresh timing. Following-based ICS is generated temporarily in your browser.
privacy.thirdParty: SEOUL.OS does not sell visitor data or sell tickets. Check the original event page for the latest changes.
calendar.statusTitle: Official schedules are not connected yet

media.localMeaning: This records local format and source validation, not successful platform access or discovery of new posts.

media.youtubeFallback: Channel data is unavailable; labeled curated or demo content is shown below.
media.eventsNote: The calendar retains reviewed event sources. An official schedule link does not imply complete event coverage here.
media.musicNote: Browse releases in the official discography. Unverified comeback dates and album entries are not generated here.
media.savedUnavailableBody: Only the bookmark ID is retained. The post may be loading, unavailable or removed from the reviewed manifest.
media.privacyBody: The media room loads official embeds only after you choose to allow them. Platforms may then receive IP, device, browser and cookie information. Closing removes the embed but cannot undo sent requests. Social videos are not downloaded or rehosted, and manual lists are not labeled automatic syncs.
media.profileMeaning: Content is rendered directly by TikTok’s official profile embed. It is not automatically discovered or cached in our manifest, and is not included in the reviewed item count below.
